key_reasoning.reason: One hook (useDataSourceStatusAnnouncer) within single page (dataSources) using existing primitives (Announcement, useAnnouncementQueue). Refactoring of dataSourceStatus.ts is light (export of pre-existing logic).

All criteria explicit in technical-analysis.md: wire announcements to status transitions, reuse Announcement+useAnnouncementQueue pattern, guard against over-announcing via diff tracking, include percentage for in-progress items, handle edge cases (null repo_name, division by zero, whitespace). No decisions open.

Exact precedent exists: Announcement + useAnnouncementQueue pattern used in FilesDropzone, RecordInput, ToasterAnnouncer. Guards added to useAnnouncementQueue (empty/whitespace checks) are defensive, not breaking. No security, performance, or auth implications. Trivial rollback.

4 production files modified (useAnnouncementQueue.ts, DataSourcesPage.tsx, DataSourceStatus.tsx, dataSourceStatus.ts) + 1 new implementation file (useDataSourceStatusAnnouncer.ts) + 3 new test files. Localized to dataSources page area and shared hooks layer.
